scope: Personal structural audit; not independent validation of each scientific result. Figure discussion is caption/text-only.

observations: History explains a methodological shift and motivates causal/clinical objective; not decorative chronological list.
Review distinguishes symptom localization from direction of information flow; scope boundary integral to definitions.
Authors propose causality continuum and selected criteria. A review contributes an organizing/evaluative framework beyond extracting facts from individual studies.
Clinical and conceptual examples include historical lesions, counterfactual/tobacco-tax analogies, cross-method coherence; experiment-only case template too narrow.
Best-practice recommendations and integration of correlative with causal methods prevent simplistic ranking or rejection of all correlation evidence.

records.version: arXiv2203.08737v1 2022-03 accepted/preprint; journal issue metadata differs
observations: Review distinguishes itself from adjacent surveys via explicit scope and related-review table; excludes memory approximation while recognizing complementarity.
Main classification is precision scaling/computation reduction/approximate units, followed by a different axis: error compensation, evaluation conditions, reliability and security.
Empirical cases explain a method and immediately expose retraining or hardware-emulation cost; cannot detach example result from these boundaries.
Cross-paper synthesis critically evaluates benchmark difficulty, network size, and baseline precision before comparing energy/accuracy; not a raw performance ranking.
Review computes some comparison quantities itself or via a library, marking source insufficiency. Synthesizer-origin analysis needs provenance distinct from quoted source results.
Figures/tables have separate jobs: scope comparison, concept taxonomy, benchmark evidence map, conditional performance comparison; table-text/caption reading only.

observations: Future-oriented review organized by achievable advances, usability, community coordination and decision needs; outlook not merely final paragraph.
Comparisons concern complementary capabilities and fitness to intended application, not absolute laboratory-accuracy ranking.
Original worked Amazon-carbon calculation in appendix requires provenance distinct from cited study results, with explicit assumptions and propagated uncertainty.
Background, evidence, constraints and actionable next steps recur within individual subsections; rhetorical functions are not fixed one-to-one with chapters.
Satellite coverage gaps and reference-data uncertainty qualify substantive conclusions; omitting qualifiers changes their meaning.
